checks: PDF2–3 Table I lists 14 levels, 13 new and one previously measured. Spins in both candidate bands have positive parity. Two entries have overlapping methods within the analysis.
PDF3 Fig. 3 and text compare same-spin E2 rates: band 1 strengths about 2–3 times band 2 in the near-degenerate region. PDF4 interprets with competing shape fluctuations and quasiparticle coupling.
PDF3 reports qualitative polarization-supported multipolarity and defers per-transition polarization and branching details. It does not populate a numeric P–δ record.
works.gap: No quantitative per-line mixed amplitudes or P inputs in this brief article. Strength differences test the stated static-limit interpretation and do not uniquely establish a dynamic mode.
works.lineage: Lifetime reply and later fuller accounts of matching data should be checked for acquisition dependency. DCO support and prior strengths use cited measurements.
